timecoded_text_to_speech.text: I'm here at Denspli implants with Vice President of Global Marketing, Dr. Björn Daly to discuss
new product offers. Björn, can you tell me what does Denspli implants total offer look
like today? Well, today we have a comprehensive solution
supporting basically all faces of implant therapy. We have our three implant systems, the
Ancholos, the Astritic implant systems and XI. Each of these systems are well proven
and has different features and benefits. Friost and is our bone regeneration concept and
product solution. Within the digital open solution, there are two strong product brands. We
have Atlantis and Simplant. Firstly, Atlantis offers patient-specific care cheme butements,
as well as a full range of implant super structures. Simplant offers a totally unique,
really surgical planning tool and a surgical guide. In addition to this, we also offer extensive
professional development and also a training education programme for clinicians, laboratory
technicians, as well as for the whole auxiliary team. And to be a powerhouse, you really have
to be innovative and cutting edge. These new product offers you say are just that, that
they really benefit clinicians and patients' house so. Well, we have the brand new well-one
concept for immediate temporary restorations. Basically, titanium wires are attached between
specifically designed abutments to support the temporary restoration. And this concept
is designed for screw-retained restorations and is available for ancholos and XI. By utilising
these concept, patients will have temporary restorations already at the time of surgery
and this procedure will eliminate the provisional restoration made of acrylic without supporting
metal frame or even in the worst case that patients leave this surgery without any formal
temporary prosthesis. And the well-one concept is really unique in the market and now only
supply by the enhanced by implants. In addition to this, we are launching the Ancule
6.6mm implant, completing the product range that we now have six implant lengths all the
way from 6.6 to 17mm. The real benefit to the clinician and also the patient is basically
that the new implants may reduce the need for bone augmentation procedures. And of course,
for all our ancholos products, the Anclus tissue care concept applies. Last but not
least, for XI implant system, we have recently introduced XI's platform switch concept,
which is restoration of implants with the diameter reduced abutments. And as such, I mean,
platform switch is not new within implant industry, but now we are launching specifically
designed restorative components that will allow for optimal platform switch.
Okay, thanks for taking the time to speak to me today, Björn.
My pleasure.
